title: Zooming without Zooming v2: From Seeing Details to Connecting Evidence for Generalizable Multimodal Perception
abstract: arXiv:2610.37037v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal perception forms the foundation of multimodal intelligence. In particular, spatial perception and multimodal long-context understanding are two pivotal tasks that underpin embodied AI and multimodal agents. However, synthesizing targeted, high-quality training data for these tasks remains difficult and costly. Our key insight is that these tasks share an underlying capability, which we call connecting evidence: identifying relevant visual facts, binding them to the correct entities, recovering their relations, and composing them into an answer. Crucially, targeted training data are far easier to synthesize for this capability than for these tasks themselves. To strengthen this capability, we propose EvidenceConnect, an easy-to-implement data synthesis framework that uses zoomed views of related regions within a single image to generate questions requiring comparison, aggregation, or chaining of visual evidence. translated_title: 无需缩放的缩放 v2：从看清细节到连接证据，实现可泛化的多模态感知
translated_abstract: 多模态感知是多模态智能的基础。其中，空间感知与多模态长上下文理解是支撑具身智能和多模态智能体的两大关键任务。然而，为这些任务合成有针对性的高质量训练数据仍然困难且成本高昂。我们的核心洞察是：这些任务共享一种底层能力，我们称之为“连接证据”，即识别相关的视觉事实、将其绑定到正确的实体、恢复它们之间的关系，并将其组合成答案。至关重要的是，针对这种底层能力合成有针对性的训练数据，远比为这些任务本身合成数据容易得多。为了增强这种能力，我们提出了 EvidenceConnect，一个易于实现的数据合成框架，它利用单张图像内相关区域的放大视图，生成需要比较、聚合或链接视觉证据的问题。为确保质量……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 论文提出 EvidenceConnect 数据合成框架，通过利用单张图像内相关区域的放大视图生成需要比较、聚合或链接视觉证据的问题，来增强多模态模型“连接证据”这一底层能力，从而以更低的成本提升空间感知与多模态长上下文理解等任务的泛化性能。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes EvidenceConnect, a simple data synthesis framework that uses zoomed views of related regions within a single image to generate questions requiring comparison, aggregation, or chaining of visual evidence, thereby strengthening the underlying "connecting evidence" capability to improve generalizable multimodal perception tasks such as spatial perception and long-context understanding at much lower cost.
